confirm.title: Holman iGardener RGB
confirm.description: Set up the Vibrance_RGB controller at {address}?

abort.no_devices_found: No Vibrance_RGB controllers found. Power-cycle the controller (it only advertises briefly) and make sure the phone app is disconnected.

unreachable.title: Holman controller {address} is not responding
unreachable.description: The Vibrance_RGB controller at {address} has been unreachable for about 15 minutes. Home Assistant marks the light unavailable after about 5 minutes and keeps trying in the background. If the controller is Bluetooth-silent and has stopped advertising, only a power-cycle will recover it: turn it off, wait 10 seconds, and turn it on. This alert clears when the link comes back.
